summary.en:
- Dr. Ratio is a Single Target DPS built around beating his enemies into submission with consistent Follow-up ATKs. 
- Debuffs are required for his kit to function, having sufficient sources is paramount to his success; 3 at the bare minimum to guarantee his Follow-up ATK and 5 will cap out A6 Trace 'Deduction'.

details.en: His  eidolons provide some damage boost and quality of life, but are not neccesary for him to function.
